title: FABLE: Fast Approximate Block-Encodings
subtitle: Block-encoding dense matrices with FABLE
description: This tutorial implements FABLE (Fast Approximate BLock-Encodings) for dense matrices with the Classiq SDK. It explains the amplitude-oracle construction and Walsh-Hadamard-domain compression, builds an exact dense block encoding, and shows how thresholding small rotation angles trades accuracy for shallower circuits.
